memories.content: Tidepool has a newsletter with 5,000 subscribers. They plan to send a launch email on 2026-09-22T08:00:00-07:00. The email includes a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. Tidepool wants at least 200 subscribers to click through and join the beta waitlist within 72 hours.

The newsletter has a typical click-through rate of 6%. The beta email is scheduled to be sent to all 5,000 subscribers at the start time. The email contains a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. Subscribers may or may not open the email, click the link, and join the waitlist.
